_comment: The Google Forms an applicant completes, in order. This is an interim route while the built-in application system waits on a database and SMTP credentials. Keeping the links here rather than hardcoded in the page means Alif can change a form URL without touching code. Verified against the live forms on 24 August 2026 - see `verified` on each.

forms.title: Pre-employment and screening questions
forms.summary: Your name, where you live, how long you have worked in care, whether you drive, and your DBS status.
forms.verified: 2026-08-24: opens publicly, no sign-in required. Title confirmed as 'Pre-employment/ screening questions', 10 questions.

forms.title: Application details
forms.summary: The second part of your application.
forms.verified: 2026-08-24: redirects to a Google sign-in page. An applicant WITHOUT a Google account cannot open this form at all. Set it to 'Responder input' instead, which is what form 1 uses. Once fixed, set requiresGoogleAccount to false and this page stops warning about it.
